sentences.en: They say one's forties are a dangerous time of life.
sentences.zh: 他们说四十岁是人生的一个危险时期。

sentences.en: He lived idly and found himself already forty years old.
sentences.zh: 他虚度光阴，发现自己已经四十岁了。

sentences.en: There is nothing abnormal in having a child around forty.
sentences.zh: 四十几岁时生孩子没什么不正常的。
